recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If future changes are needed to cqlOptions context, cardinality, or option parameters, make them in the FHIR Extension Pack, CRMI IG, or CQL IG as appropriate.
issue_request: FHIR-32670 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by CDS and requested a cqf-cqlOptions extension, 0..1 Reference(Parameters), for CQL-to-ELM translator options on CQL Libraries and Manifest or asset-collection use.
initial_application: No current core commit was found with FHIR-32670 in the message. The Jira comment points to HL7/fhir#2635, whose core commit added a related CRMI Using CQL link. The actual cqf-cqlOptions StructureDefinition was added in the FHIR Extension Pack by dee8f223157f3148a3348a92613bf52cb9652f31, and the related FHIR-30570 snapshot records that extension-pack commit together with the core PR application.
additional_context: Current core does not own the extension definition. It lists cqf-cqlOptions in the Clinical Reasoning module and reserves its OID, while the current Extension Pack source defines max 0..1 and value Reference(Parameters). CRMIManifestLibrary is a Library profile for asset collections and slices Library.extension:cqlOptions, so the seed's Manifest use case is covered by the Library context. Later FHIR-45323 and FHIR-43908 work refined Extension Pack metadata and downstream CQL IG parameter profiling without requiring a core-source change.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current FHIR core checkout has no stale or contradictory Library text to correct, and duplicating the extension definition in core would be wrong because the Extension Pack is the current source of truth.
